chapter_title: SCOMET: Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies
title: Any on-site inspection will be allowed by the applicant exporter if required
text: 1. Any on-site inspection will be allowed by the applicant exporter if required by the DGFT or authorized representatives of the Government of India;
